description: Browse the PCFHub catalog by category, tag, author, control type, host or text, paged and sorted. Use it to enumerate or narrow the catalog; use search for a plain-language question about what a control should do, and get_component for one control in full. Filters take slugs, which list_taxonomy supplies. Nothing here fails on bad input: an unrecognised sort falls back to the default, and filters matching nothing return an empty page — so read `total` and `sort` from the result rather than assuming the filters applied.

control_type.description: field binds one column on a form; dataset renders a view; virtual is a React control; grid_customizer changes how an editable grid renders cells.

host.description: Where the control has to run. A control supporting both hosts matches either.

query.description: Words to match against names, taglines and descriptions.

sort.description: Defaults to relevance when there is a query, newest otherwise.

tags.description: Tag slugs, from list_taxonomy. A control must carry every tag given.

name: list_components

builtWith.description: ai where an AI assistant wrote the code, ai-assisted where a person wrote it with one. Null where the author has not said.

hosts.description: Where this control runs. Empty only where nobody has declared it.

latestVersion.description: Null where nothing has been released yet.

supportLevel.description: maintained, or reference: a worked example not maintained for production. Null where the author has not said.

url.description: Absolute URL of the control's page.

lastPage.description: The highest page number for these filters.

sort.description: The sort actually applied, which is the default when none was given or the one given was not recognised.

total.description: Controls matching the filters, across every page.

title: List PCF controls
